label: Everyday Location
description: Ordinary places rendered lovingly — the slice-of-life and lifestyle staple.

items.name: corner-cafe
items.text: A small corner café, steam on the espresso machine, mismatched wooden chairs and handwritten menu boards.

items.name: sunlit-kitchen
items.text: A lived-in kitchen in warm light, copper pans hanging, herbs on the windowsill and flour still on the counter.

items.name: secondhand-bookshop
items.text: A cramped secondhand bookshop, shelves sagging, paper smell almost visible, a ladder leaning into the stacks.

items.name: glass-greenhouse
items.text: A domestic glass greenhouse crowded with seedlings, terracotta pots and a watering can on the gravel path.

items.name: night-laundromat
items.text: An empty laundromat, fluorescent hum, one machine spinning, the street dark beyond the glass.

items.name: rooftop-garden
items.text: A city rooftop garden of raised beds and string lights, skyline soft in the background.

items.name: farmers-market
items.text: A weekend farmers market, striped awnings, crates of produce and paper bags changing hands.

items.name: window-reading-nook
items.text: A bay-window reading nook with a worn armchair, a folded blanket and a tea tray on the sill.

items.name: record-store
items.text: A vinyl record store, crates alphabetized by hand, gig posters layered on every wall.

items.name: tram-interior
items.text: The interior of an old city tram, worn wooden seats, hand straps swaying, the city sliding past outside.

items.name: metro-platform
items.text: An underground metro platform, glazed enamel wall tiles, a curved tunnel mouth and the route map glowing in its lightbox.

items.name: barbershop
items.text: A classic barbershop, worn leather-and-chrome chairs facing a long mirror, clippers hanging on hooks and a striped pole by the door.

items.name: petrol-station-canopy
items.text: A petrol station on an empty road, the white canopy a box of light over the pumps, moths circling and the shop glowing behind glass.

items.name: flower-shop
items.text: A florist's shop spilling onto the pavement, zinc buckets of cut stems banked in tiers, handwritten price tags and stray petals scattered on wet concrete.
